newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 7.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says Taiwan must
Pete Sampras, Martina Hingis win Wimbledon.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Central American countries affirm support for Taiwan to join United Nations.
Taiwan's first whale-watching boat sights whales off eastern Hualien coast.
LIBERTY TIMES - Cabinet reshuffle expected in early September.
About 80 percent of top Taiwan government officials born before World War Two.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Textile firms show keen interest to invest in Central America.
Hong Kong aims to strengthen development of high-tech industry.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Nan Ya Technology plans T$100 billion wafer plant.
Finance ministry to discuss possibility of afternoon session for stock market.
